svg.title: Video Template G BPM workflow — Music Video
svg.desc: Seven-phase governed video production BPM workflow for Music Video. It shows greenlight, pre-production, production, post, release review, distribution, post-launch learning, quality gates, typed artifacts, principal agents, targeted rework, and fail-closed runtime status.
svg.metadata: Generated from spec/production_scale_framework.md. Visual system follows ui/public/svg/video.workflow.svg. Evidence basis: Detailed S4 flow; an explicit S2-light exception exists below the primary S3–S5 range. Runtime remains fail-closed; capability maps do not activate tools, network, or production.

g.text: Video Template G · Music Video BPM Workflow
Shared seven-phase production skeleton · specialized tasks, crew, gates, handoffs and feedback
FAIL-CLOSED — This workflow is a capability/scheduling design. It does not activate network, tools, providers or production without separate host and human gates.
Scale is selected before archetype. Typed handoffs carry correlation, evidence, quality, rights and HiTL state.
Coordinate song-led visual concept, performance, picture/audio
pipelines, rights and label distribution. Live + AI VFX music
videos, premium performance films and label/digital campaigns.
explicit S2-light exception exists below the primary S3–S5
Strict craft QC; sample/rights clearance; deepfake and consent
review; parallel picture, sound and marketing.
Host-owned orchestration, evidence, memory and approvals span all seven phases.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Align artist brief, song, audience and visual ambition.
• Create rights, sample and likeness register.
• Sample and identity rights must be traceable.
• Freeze creative and campaign success criteria.
Artist brief · concept target · budget · rights register
Revise concept, rights or production scope.
PARALLEL FAN-OUT / FAN-IN · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Build concept pack, boards and lookbook.
• Plan choreography, casting and production design.
• Define picture, sound and marketing lanes.
• L1 checks concept, performance and coverage.
• Consent and sample state must be known.
Concept pack · performance plan · boards · clearances
Return failed design, casting or rights item.
PARALLEL FAN-OUT / FAN-IN · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Picture: DoP, camera/prompt pool, continuity, VFX.
• Audio: score/stems, mix and music supervision.
• Run per-shot QA and performance review.
• Picture, sound and marketing execute in parallel.
Picture takes · audio assets · render telemetry
Rerender, rerecord or restage failed element.
PARALLEL FAN-OUT / FAN-IN · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Edit performance and VFX to music structure.
• Grade picture and complete final mix.
• Develop trailer and social cutdowns before lock.
• Picture lock and music rights precede master.
• Check beat sync, identity and continuity.
Picture lock · grade · final mix · cutdowns
Return failed picture, sound or campaign cut.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Run Legal, Compliance and consent checks.
• Judge and GateKeeper consolidate release evidence.
• S4 quality: strict L2 + rights/deepfake HiTL.
• Blocked sample or identity halts release.
Route legal, identity or craft notes to owner.
PARALLEL FAN-OUT / FAN-IN · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Each branch validates metadata and rights.
• Territory and embargo constraints are preserved.
Label package · platform masters · campaign assets
Repackage only failed outlet or territory.
GOVERNED SEQUENCE · TYPED ARTIFACT HANDOFF · BOUNDED REWORK
• Measure audience, community, ROAS and retention.
• Compare song moments and cutdown performance.
• Do not rewrite released masters silently.
Campaign report · audience signals · next-plan tickets
Feed tested learning into the next release plan.
HANDOFF CONTRACT — correlation_id · from/to agent · artifact_ref/type · scale · archetype · evidence_refs · L1/L2 · rights_state · needs_hitl
Offline/UAT runs also emit knowledge_usage. Crew lists are capability maps; host policy remains authoritative.
Evidence basis: Detailed S4 flow; an explicit S2-light exception exists below the primary S3–S5 range.
Principal unique agents linked in this diagram: 37 · Seven phases · fail-closed runtime · no automatic scale promotion.
